note: Official docs checked where listed; no accounts, keys, paid requests or live credentialed connector tests performed during planning.

connectors.purpose: Filings, historical exhibits, operating context and financial period facts; follow older submissions files and accession document indexes.
connectors.access: Public read API; identify operator with a real contact User-Agent. Global limiter below documented 10 requests/second maximum.
connectors.limits: Not a complete pre-IPO archive. Filed date is not action date; financial period end is not filed date. Companyfacts does not replace reading exhibits.
connectors.verified: official docs reviewed 2026-09-08; credentialed execution not tested

routes: Company-specific newsrooms, history pages, catalogs, pricing pages, RSS/sitemaps, official investor archives
connectors.purpose: Product features, pricing, marketing messages, hiring announcements, launch terms and first-party retrospective accounts.
connectors.access: Per-domain allowlist, robots/terms review, conditional requests, bounded fetches; no assumed universal API.
connectors.limits: Official does not mean independently verified. Publicity is not retention evidence; claims of success must remain attributed.

routes: Authenticated PDF/HTML/text/image upload and source registration
connectors.purpose: Historic catalogs, scans, company-provided records and authorized licensed documents.
connectors.access: Tenant isolation, provenance/rights declaration, size/type limits, malware screening and sandboxed parsing.
connectors.limits: Uploader assertions not automatic verification. Private documents never enter other tenants' stories.

routes: Select current Patent File Wrapper and bulk-data endpoints from official catalog/OpenAPI during connector implementation; do not guess route or pin legacy beta API.
connectors.purpose: Applications, publications, grants and prosecution records; map identifiers, assignees and explicit product references.
connectors.access: USPTO.gov registration and API key; user completes account/identity steps. Catalog page did not expose schema in this research tool.
connectors.limits: Do not assume full 19th/20th-century coverage or infer product linkage from assignee alone. Filing, priority, publication and grant are distinct.
connectors.verified: registration policy verified; exact credentialed contract remains a preflight gate

routes: Import current official OPS OpenAPI; bibliographic, family and legal-event resources
connectors.purpose: International patent family, bibliographic and legal-event cross-checks.
connectors.access: Registration and OAuth credentials. Official free tier lists up to 4 GB/week; quota and license recheck before enabling.
connectors.limits: Coverage varies by authority. Legal event does not prove current enforceability; do not offer legal conclusions.
connectors.verified: official capability/access docs reviewed; live credentials not tested

connectors.purpose: Court opinions, dockets and available RECAP documents linked to relevant products and parties.
connectors.access: Token authentication for production. Current docs default 5/minute, 50/hour, 125/day; use account limits and usage API. No automatic paid PACER requests.
connectors.limits: Incomplete jurisdictions/dockets and missing documents. Case filed, ruling and resolution dates differ; absence is not compliance.
connectors.verified: official v4.7 docs reviewed; permissioned endpoints require preflight

connectors.purpose: Discover dated snapshots of historical official pricing, marketing and product pages.
connectors.access: Low request rate, cache, backoff, availability check and rights assessment. No SLA assumed.
connectors.limits: Capture date proves observation, not launch/effective date. Many pages/assets unavailable; archive timestamp alone never exactifies a business event.
connectors.verified: official repository documentation reviewed; live archive availability not tested

connectors.purpose: UK legal identity, filings and officer history for newly added companies.
connectors.access: User-provided API key; read-only client; confirm API spec/rate limits before enabling.
connectors.limits: Legal incorporation is not product inception or operational maturity. Registered officers are not an employee census.

routes: Choose dataset-specific drug/device approval, clearance, labeling and recall resources from current catalog; don't use adverse-event API as an approval database.
connectors.purpose: US healthcare product regulatory milestones with authoritative identifiers.
connectors.access: Plan for user API key. Authentication page lists keyed and unkeyed quotas; verify actual account contract. Redact api_key from URL logs.
connectors.limits: Dataset/period coverage differs. Regulatory approval is not product-market fit or a complete compliance assessment.
connectors.verified: official overview/auth docs reviewed; dataset selection pending

connectors.purpose: Identifiers, aliases, predecessor discovery and source leads.
connectors.access: CC0 structured data; courtesy limiter and descriptive User-Agent.
connectors.limits: Community data is not primary proof of dates, employment, product ownership or stage.

routes: Existing gdelt_client; explicitly authorized search/forum APIs only
connectors.purpose: Find leads, counterexamples and original documents.
connectors.access: Provider terms, API approval and quotas required; no paid service or scrape bypass authorized by this plan.
connectors.limits: Search snippets are not evidence. Preserve author/date and trace source. No LinkedIn scraping, employee inference or unrestricted Reddit crawling.
connectors.verified: existing discovery clients inspected by inventory; new provider access not verified
